quality_first.rule: quality gates always outrank speed and automation

utf8_only.rule: if mojibake or invalid UTF-8 is detected, stop immediately

auto_run_meaning.rule: continue next unit only; do not batch-generate large ranges

script_run_not_required.rule: script execution is optional; orchestration continuity does not imply code execution

phase0_before_tr.rule: TR generation is forbidden before phase0_design exists

tr_before_bi.rule: BI generation is forbidden before verified TR exists

audit_before_complete.rule: completion cannot be declared before audit pass

stage0_preprocess.go_condition: all four stage0 contract files exist and manual_audit_pass == true

planning.go_condition: phase0_design exists and minimum contract is satisfied

production.go_condition: produce one block, leave manual audit, then advance to the next block only

bi.go_condition: BI is allowed only after source TR handoff gate pass and one manual audit note
